dynamicTools.description: Read this shared conversation's current memories and jobs. Forgotten memories are tombstones, not valid facts. Candidate memories are unconfirmed. Native personal memory is separate.

dynamicTools.description: Persist an explicit remember, correct or forget request from the current user message. Call before claiming success. Personal preferences belong to that message's author, not every member. For an existing memory supply its id and baseRevision from recall. Use operation upsert or forget, scope member or space.
dynamicTools.name: shadow_remember

dynamicTools.description: Maintain durable work. start requires title/prompt and completionCriteria; kind work uses an independent background session, coordination uses the current main segment. Finish the foreground turn after dispatch. update/cancel/resume require id/baseVersion. checkpoint/wait/finish require id/baseVersion/baseRevision from status plus a checkpoint. wait records exact discussion question, request, child job or an explicitly requested check time, then end this turn; answers resume the same task automatically without model polling. Retain dependency IDs when an answer is insufficient; only new answers wake it again. Resolve dependencies by citing their actual signalIds and explaining why the condition is met. finish requires outcome/result; completed also requires a criteriaChecks entry for every completion criterion and no unresolved dependency. A native final alone never completes the task. status with id reads complete task state; without id it returns a bounded index; unknown native input must be reconciled, not replayed.

dynamicTools.description: Read and maintain the owner's private understanding of followed objects in an owner-originated request. read uses id or exact subject; list is paged. start follows the existing space object and stores an optional goal; update changes that goal; pause/resume controls analysis without changing the member follow; complete ends the stated goal while ordinary future updates can still refresh understanding. Writes need a stable requestId and baseGoalVersion from read (0 if absent). Native turn completion does not complete a goal. These are direct operations, not approval requests. Other members' shared requests use public sources and their actual tasks, not the owner's private follow list.

messages.text: 请关注准确对象 {kind:discussion,id:watch-discussion}，目标是持续了解旧客户端 v3 兼容性，只了解事实，暂无行动。 使用 shadow_watch 实际保存后，简短回答 WATCH_STARTED。这是独立测试，不调用 shell、网络或其他 MCP，不创建任务，不联系其他人。
对同一对象使用 shadow_watch update，把关注目标改为持续了解离线升级恢复，只了解事实。先 read 取得当前目标版本。 使用 shadow_watch 实际保存后，简短回答 WATCH_UPDATED。这是独立测试，不调用 shell、网络或其他 MCP，不创建任务，不联系其他人。
对同一对象使用 shadow_watch pause，暂时暂停分析并保留排队动态。先 read 取得当前目标版本。 使用 shadow_watch 实际保存后，简短回答 WATCH_PAUSED。这是独立测试，不调用 shell、网络或其他 MCP，不创建任务，不联系其他人。
对同一对象使用 shadow_watch resume，按原有离线升级恢复目标继续了解排队动态。先 read 取得当前目标版本。 使用 shadow_watch 实际保存后，简短回答 WATCH_RESUMED。这是独立测试，不调用 shell、网络或其他 MCP，不创建任务，不联系其他人。
对同一对象使用 shadow_watch complete，结束当前关注目标并保留已有认识。先 read 取得当前目标版本。 使用 shadow_watch 实际保存后，简短回答 WATCH_COMPLETED。这是独立测试，不调用 shell、网络或其他 MCP，不创建任务，不联系其他人。
